Thanks, Ruth. Plain description for the pitch:

Calder is an AI assistant a household can use to keep everyday admin and decisions organised: answering practical questions, helping draft messages and lists, summarising information, and reminding the household what needs attention. It is not a human adviser and we should not promise it will pay bills, make bookings, or act autonomously unless we have built and tested that.

For a shop, Calder helps with customer questions, product information, stock/admin lists, drafting replies, and summarising enquiries so staff spend less time on routine back-and-forth. Again, do not promise automatic ordering, payments, accounting, or full staff replacement.

The first four weeks free apply to both households and shops. After that: $12/week per household and $30/week per shop. Please make the pitch clear that launch is Monday 16 March and the product page goes live that day.
